title: Explain a PWM/PSSM score versus binding affinity: TP73 and TSS promoter traces

catalog.notes: Learn PWM/PSSM position weight and position-specific scoring matrices, PFM counts and motif logos. Explain JASPAR TFBS match scores, pseudocounts, log odds, raw LLR bits, relative scores, quantiles and inclusive background tail probability; distinguish sequence preference from binding affinity, occupancy and reporter activity. Explain why the TP73 MA0861.2 score 300 was wrong and reproduce the corrected 9.632959861247 tail score. Compare promoter/TSS traces with shared scales and interpret sparse peaks. Covers jaspar-mapping imports and reduced promoter-cofactor packages. Offline teaching guide: no loaded project required; replay needs a built GENtle CLI, with the independent scanner optional.
